messages:
nina-support: Customer (AcmeCorp) reports they can't start free trial — our API returns a payment error even after they add a card. They hit the flow, complete 3DS, then see trial blocked. Need urgent help, customer on a demo call in 45m.

ben-billing: Which API call is failing? Do you have a request_id / payment_intent id?

nina-support: Request: POST /v1/trials create -> returns 402 / payment_required. PaymentIntent attached id: pi_3Kxyz_example. Here's the response we get from our payment provider in the flow:

```
{"id":"pi_3Kxyz_example","status":"requires_action","next_action":{"type":"use_stripe_sdk","redirect_to_url":{"url":"https://3ds.example/redirect"}},"last_payment_error":null}
```

Customer completes 3DS in the browser but the issuer seems to cancel the challenge; our webhook shows `payment_intent`.`status` ended up `canceled` within 30s. Trial grant job rejects when not `succeeded`.

billing-bot: [webhook] payment_intent.canceled for pi_3Kxyz_example at 1963456798 (retries: 3)

alex-oncall: This pattern looks like issuer-initiated cancellation after challenge screens which we've seen with some issuers in EU. Our trial flow currently requires `payment_intent.status == succeeded` before granting. If the issuer cancels, there's no fallback.

claire-eng: We shipped a tightening change last month that enforces the pretrial check to only allow succeeded intents. It prevents spoofed autorization but breaks some 3DS UIs that return canceled then later webhook `payment_method.attached`.

nina-support: Repro steps from customer: 1) create trial 2) attach card via tokenization form 3) confirm PI with return_url 4) 3DS shows challenge -> user completes -> issuer returns cancel -> PI canceled -> trial fails. Timestamps: 1963456796 -> 1963456798. Card last4: 4242.

olivia-support-lead: We should offer a manual grant immediately to unblock the demo. Create internal incident and escalate for a short-term fallback. I've created INC-2026-741. @ben-billing please grant 7 days trial credit and log grant id.

ben-billing: Manual grant done: GRANT-1963456789, 7 days, note "AcmeCorp demo - issuer 3DS cancellation". Invoice system flagged nothing else.

claire-eng: For a robust fix: we can add a guarded fallback that, for specific issuer patterns (issuer cancels within X seconds and we see a subsequent `payment_method.attached` webhook), we queue a manual review and surface clearer logs. I can open a PR for a canary today, ETA ~6 hours.

alex-oncall: Short-term workaround: tell customer to try a different card or use corporate card, or try again later. I'll also enable extra debug logs on the payment path for the canary so we can trace the 3DS lifecycle.

nina-support: On demo call now, shared manual grant. Customer asked if we can accept `requires_action` -> Claire noted policy risk. I'll update them and request they try another card.

claire-eng: I'll tag the PR with INC-2026-741 and include repro steps + the PI id. If we find this affects more customers we'll consider relaxing the check for a limited set of issuers.

olivia-support-lead: Thanks team. Please post follow-up here when PR is out and when we close the incident. +@ben-billing can you attach the grant to the ticket?

ben-billing: Attached GRANT-1963456789 to INC-2026-741.

nina-support: :thumbsup: closing loop with customer now, will add their feedback to the incident.
